claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Cosmetic condition and import history cannot be judged from body/lens shots shown; model and lens are supported but 'UK used' and 'neat' are seller description only.
Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 'Canon EOS 800' on body; lens barrel reads 'Canon EF-S 18-55mm'.
No menu screen or shutter-count app screenshot shown; cannot be read from exterior photos.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens cap is on in all three photos; front and rear glass elements are not visible.
Not shown in any photo; only the camera body and lens are pictured.
Internal service history cannot be determined from external photos.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements with cap off, held against light
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown, assume possible optical defect

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a shutter-count checking app/website
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-use/unknown shutter count, not as low-count claimed

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be included or may be third-party
risks.proof: Photo of battery and charger together with camera and lens in one frame
risks.if_unproven: priced as body and lens only, accessories not included

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or autofocus/LCD may be faulty
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, LCD flip-out and live view, and autofocus attempting focus

risks.risk: Sensor dust, dead pixels, or internal damage not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of a test shot (e.g., plain white/blue sky) taken with the camera, or sensor close-up

risks.risk: Body cosmetic wear (dents, scratches) hidden by hand placement or angle
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos including top, bottom, and underside without hand covering it
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderate cosmetic wear assumed

proof_requests: Photo of lens front and rear elements with cap removed, against light
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or shutter-count app
Photo of battery and charger together with the camera
Video of camera powering on, LCD opening, and autofocus working
Photo of a test shot taken with the camera to check sensor
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a Canon EOS 800D with 18-55mm lens, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified shutter count, lens condition, accessory inclusion, and functionality.
